Posted by Darrin Black 52 pm Sentiment for Ebix Inc (NASDAQ:EBIX)
Ebix Inc (NASDAQ:EBIX) institutional sentiment increased to 1.45 in 2018 Q3 . Its up 0.04, from 1.41 in 2018Q2. The ratio has improved, as 90 investment professionals opened new and increased positions, while 62 sold and decreased equity positions in Ebix Inc. The investment professionals in our partner’s database now have: 22.77 million shares, up from 20.60 million shares in 2018Q2. Also, the number of investment professionals holding Ebix Inc in their top 10 positions was flat from 4 to 4 for the same number . Sold All: 17 Reduced: 45 Increased: 54 New Position: 36.
Ebix, Inc. provides software and e-commerce solutions to insurance, finance, and healthcare industries. The company has market cap of $1.39 billion. It offers software development, customization, and consulting services to various entities in the insurance industry, including carriers, brokers, exchanges, and standard making bodies. It has a 12.64 P/E ratio. The firm operates data exchanges in the areas of life insurance, annuities, employee health benefits, risk management, workers compensation, insurance underwriting, and property and casualty insurance.
The stock increased 1.33% or $0.58 during the last trading session, reaching $44.35. About 219,701 shares traded. Ebix, Inc. (NASDAQ:EBIX) has declined 38.37% since January 7, 2018 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 38.37% the S&P500.
Analysts await Ebix, Inc. (NASDAQ:EBIX) to report earnings on March, 7. They expect $0.90 earnings per share, up 7.14 % or $0.06 from last year’s $0.84 per share. EBIX’s profit will be $28.15 million for 12.32 P/E if the $0.90 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.92 actual earnings per share reported by Ebix, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -2.17 % negative EPS growth.
P2 Capital Partners Llc holds 5.9% of its portfolio in Ebix, Inc. for 830,000 shares. Villere St Denis J & Co Llc owns 1.07 million shares or 5.13% of their US portfolio. Moreover, Ashford Capital Management Inc has 3.28% invested in the company for 342,966 shares. The Pennsylvania-based Millrace Asset Group Inc. has invested 2.06% in the stock. Tealwood Asset Management Inc, a Minnesota-based fund reported 69,664 shares.
Since January 1, 0001, it had 2 insider purchases, and 3 insider sales for $10.20 million activity. Ebix, Inc. (NASDAQ:EBIX) Ratings Coverage
Ratings analysis reveals 50% of Ebix’s analysts are positive. Out of 2 Wall Street analysts rating Ebix, 1 give it “Buy”, 0 “Sell” rating, while 1 recommend “Hold”. The lowest target is $85 while the high is $11300. The stock’s average target of $99 is 123.22% above today’s ($44.35) share price. EBIX was included in 3 notes of analysts from July 12, 2018. On Thursday, November 29 the stock rating was maintained by Maxim Group with “Buy”.
